No Israeli distributor, dealer or subsidiary was found. Four approaches found no Israeli entity: 'A&D balance' and 'A&D Company Japan balances GX GF' restricted to the Israeli distributor domain list (only generic MRC balance guides), 'A&D Israel distributor' restricted to aandd.jp (corporate pages only; the global network page's Israel entry, if any, is not indexed), and two .co.il-wide searches ('A&D analytical balance Japan GX-A HR-A', 'A&D Weighing') that returned Labotal/MRC/Ohaus/Precisa balance pages and unrelated hits. The brand name is hard to search (ampersand) and A&D may be sold in Israel through a weighing/industrial-scale importer rather than a lab distributor, or supplied from abroad; no credible lead was seen. Result: none_found after English, Hebrew-domain and manufacturer-site searches.

[אימות עדכניות 10/2026] Re-checked on 2026-10-15: a search restricted to Yamato's own domains again returned only the global partners page (yamato-scientific.com/global/) naming S.L. Moran Ltd (Shatner Center bldg 7, Givat Shaul, Jerusalem, +972-74-7029898) as the Israel sales representative, and the search tool again flagged the page as roughly eight years old (c. 2018). A search restricted to slmoran.co.il returned only a 2019/2020 Van der Heijden catalogue and no Yamato content, and a general English/Hebrew search found no Israeli distributor (Agentek appeared only as an unrelated generic hit). The listing therefore rests on a dated page and could not be confirmed as current. A search restricted to Yamato's own domains returned its global partners page (yamato-scientific.com/global/), whose snippet lists S.L. Moran Ltd, Shatner Center building 7, Givat Shaul, Jerusalem, with a +972 phone number as the Israel representative; the search tool flagged the page as roughly 3,000 days old, so the listing may be stale. A follow-up search restricted to slmoran.co.il returned no Yamato content (only a Van der Heijden catalogue and the about page), and a .co.il-wide search found only a BioFindly directory entry describing Yamato without naming an Israeli agent. S.L. Moran is an active Israeli lab-equipment importer (it hosts 2025 Huber material), so the listing is plausible but unconfirmed from the distributor side.
